name: 06706 · Waterbury, CT
findings: ZIP 06706 (Waterbury) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06706 (Waterbury) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
